definitions.explanation: Acting or speaking without thinking carefully about the consequences. Describes careless, hasty behavior.

examples.japanese: {軽|かる}はずみな{発言|はつげん}をしてしまった。
{軽|かる}はずみな{行動|こうどう}は{慎|つつし}んでください。
{軽|かる}はずみに{約束|やくそく}してしまい、あとで{後悔|こうかい}した。
examples.english: I thoughtlessly made a promise and regretted it later.

notes:
{軽|かる}はずみ describes acting or speaking impulsively without considering the consequences. Always carries a negative connotation.

FORMS:
- {軽|かる}はずみな〜: na-adjective modifier
- {軽|かる}はずみに: adverbially (rashly, thoughtlessly)
- {軽|かる}はずみ: noun (rashness, thoughtlessness)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {軽|かる}はずみな{発言|はつげん}: careless remark
- {軽|かる}はずみな{行動|こうどう}: rash behavior
- {軽|かる}はずみに{約束|やくそく}する: to promise rashly
- {軽|かる}はずみに{口|くち}にする: to blurt out thoughtlessly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- うかつ: careless, negligent (about overlooking something)
- {早|はや}まる: to be hasty, to act prematurely
- {無謀|むぼう}: reckless (more extreme, about dangerous actions)

cross_references.label: to be hasty, to act prematurely
